answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond before it may work: real capital, slashed the moment its output is falsified. On the shared terrace every stall rents a marble plinth - heavy, priced, one per owner - while a sybil army can only afford painted opal, all flash and no weight under the appraiser lamp. Since identity must be paid for in value that burns on exposure, one operator gains nothing from a thousand masks: every duplicate multiplies the deposit at risk, and honest work simply refunds the stake.
